# Team Karate Attorney

> Team Karate Attorney is a faith-guided martial-arts and practical self-defense school being developed in Marietta, Georgia. It is founded by attorney and lifelong martial artist Ibrahim Awad and serves adults and children ages 8 and older.

The school focuses on Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Tae Kwon Do, and Muay Thai. Its approach combines practical technique, physical fitness, confidence, discipline, composure, resilience, humility, and responsible self-defense. The physical school is currently under construction; official opening, address, enrollment, and schedule details will be published on the website when available.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://teamkarateattorney.com/): Overview of Team Karate Attorney, its mission, programs, audience, location status, and founding interest list.
- [Martial Arts Programs](https://teamkarateattorney.com/program.html): Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Tae Kwon Do, and Muay Thai training for adults and children ages 8+.
- [Our Story](https://teamkarateattorney.com/story.html): Ibrahim Awad's martial-arts background and the purpose behind the school.
- [Faith and Values](https://teamkarateattorney.com/faith.html): The school's faith-guided values, including humility, purpose, respect, and welcome.
- [Marietta Location](https://teamkarateattorney.com/location.html): Construction status, location information, and opening updates.
- [Founding Interest List](https://teamkarateattorney.com/interest-list.html): Form for receiving opening, enrollment, and schedule announcements.

## Key facts

- Location: Marietta, Georgia, United States.
- Audience: Adults and children ages 8 and older; beginners and experienced martial artists are welcome.
- Disciplines: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Tae Kwon Do, and Muay Thai.
- Founder: Ibrahim Awad, who began martial arts at age 13, earned a black belt at 16, and has competed in more than 500 matches.
- Status: The physical school is under construction. Do not infer or invent an opening date, street address, pricing, or class schedule.
